column1: # The compilation host's curated mutant catalogue.
# Columns, tab separated: the mutant's name, the file it edits relative to
# runtime/compile-host, and the sed expression that applies it. The campaign
# (mise run compile-host:mutants) applies each row to a scratch copy of the
# tree and requires the regression suite to fail; a row whose edit matches
# nothing is reported as a catalogue defect rather than as a kill.
# Every row names a decision surface the slice claims to defend, so the
# catalogue reads as the claim list and the campaign reads as its audit. The
# coverage is exactly as wide as this file — that is the cost of a curated set
# and it is the honest statement of what the campaign measures.
